name: goals-plan-reminder-refused
description: An agent includes a reminder in update_plan. The production-shaped freeze callback must prepare its signed consent through the operator, rather than silently dropping the new phase field. A foreign goal domain is refused before any approval or execution authority is created. Positive signed consent, dispatcher launch, and revocation are separately covered by the production API tests.
userTurns: Include a private reminder in my plan

phases.label: Schedule reminder
phases.why: The user requested a private reminder

args.text: The reminder was refused; no execution was authorized.
